It has been represented in the [[House of Representatives of the Philippines|House of Representatives]] since 1987.{{cite web|url=http://www.congress.gov.ph/legislators/?v=province |title=Roster of Philippine legislators |publisher=[[House of Representatives of the Philippines]] |accessdate=February 11, 2021}} The district consists of the provincial capital city of [[San Fernando, Pampanga|San Fernando]] and adjacent municipalities of [[Arayat, Pampanga|Arayat]], [[Bacolor]], [[Mexico, Pampanga|Mexico]] and [[Santa Ana, Pampanga|Santa Ana]].{{cite web|url=https://www.chanrobles.com/ordinance.htm |title=The 1987 Constitution of the Republic of the Philippines |publisher=Chan Robles Virtual Law Library |accessdate=February 11, 2021}} It is currently represented in the [[20th Congress of the Philippines|20th Congress]] by [[Mica Gonzales]] of the [[Lakas–CMD]].{{cite web|url=http://www.congress.gov.ph/members/ |title=House Members |publisher=[[House of Representatives of the Philippines]] |accessdate=February 11, 2021}} ==Representation history== {| class=wikitable |- ! rowspan="2" | # ! rowspan="2" colspan=2 | Image ! rowspan="2" | Member ! colspan=2 | Term of office ! rowspan="2" | Congress ! rowspan="2" | Party ! rowspan="2" | Electoral history ! rowspan="2" | Constituent
